title: Code review items stay with a card, and fixes go straight back to the reviewer
text: Once a code review has run on a card, its items and their history stay with the card through every later handover, also on projects that only review on request. Before, the agent's next handover dropped the whole list, so the following review started from nothing and never checked whether the fixes held. Now a handover with fixes sends them straight to the reviewer, which checks each one and marks it fixed or reopens it with its reasons, while new findings continue the numbering.
